newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers to redeem convertible notes.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers to redeem convertible notes.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said Friday that it has issued a notice to redeem one-half of its 5-1/4 percent convertible subordinated notes due November 1, 2003.
The company said $31.8 million principal amount of the notes will be redeemed December 2.

Notes called may be converted into common stock or cash on or before November 29 for $23.125 per share. Notes called but not converted will be redeemed at 103.675 percent plus accrued interest, the company said.
Cross Timbers said $63.7 million in notes remain outstanding from the initial 1993 offering of $74.8 million.
